title: Kissed Butter Slovakian Tripe Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Slovakian dish featuring tender tripe in a rich and buttery beurre-monte sauce, perfect for a cozy evening meal.

ingredients.name: tripe
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: In a large pot, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the tripe, carrots, and celery, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the beef broth, white wine, thyme, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the tripe is tender.
Stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter until melted and smooth.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Serve with a side of crusty bread or over mashed vegetables, if desired.
